description: Android Portal client: SDL3 app integration and the native Vulkan renderer, packaged as a debug- or release-signed APK by build-android-apk.sh.

intent.support_scope: Android build and packaging slice (R01/R03 cross-build probe, R29 groundwork). Not platform acceptance: device lifecycle, texture-format, performance and store checks are open.
intent.packaging: APK from SDK build-tools (aapt2, d8, zipalign, apksigner); licensed Portal content is pushed separately to the app-specific external files directory
intent.display: Windowed fullscreen (+mat_windowed_fullscreen 1): every orientation the user's rotation lock allows; rotation and foldable display swaps resize the back buffer

ndk.note: sha1 and size are Google's published repository2-3.xml values; sha256 was computed from the verified archive on 2026-09-22.

sdl3.note: Same SDL3 version as the Linux profile's pkg-config pin. Provides libSDL3.so and the SDLActivity Java sources.

vendored.source: thirdparty submodule (revision pinned by the superproject)

required_checks: apksigner verify and zipalign -c -P 16 on the produced APK
installed-package smoke on an x86_64 emulator and an arm64 device
rotation (adb emu rotate) and fold/unfold (adb emu fold/unfold) keep presenting at the new size

known_blockers: Source DXT (BC) textures need BC support or transcoding; most phone GPUs lack BC (RFC 0008 R55/R58)
Surface teardown on backgrounding is not yet synchronized with SDL's surfaceDestroyed callback
